scripts.build-native: npm run build:ts && npm run bundle-pkg && npx pkg dist-pkg/bundled.cjs --compress GZip --public-packages "*" --public --no-bytecode --target node18-win-x64 --output dist/uploader-win.exe && npx pkg dist-pkg/bundled.cjs --compress GZip --public-packages "*" --public --no-bytecode --target node18-macos-x64 --output dist/uploader-macos && npx pkg dist-pkg/bundled.cjs --compress GZip --public-packages "*" --public --no-bytecode --target node18-linux-x64 --output dist/uploader-linux
scripts.build-docker: docker build -t uploader-builder . && id=$(docker create uploader-builder) && docker cp $id:/app/uploader dist/uploader-linux-docker && docker rm $id
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build-native && npm run build-docker
scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run build
